title: Viral Talking Objects Input Schema
description: Complete input specification for creating viral TikTok 'Talking Objects' content packages

character.title: 1. Character
character.description: The object to anthropomorphize as the main character (e.g., lemon, cutting board, water bottle, pencil, sunscreen)

topic.title: 3. Story Topic
topic.description: The main topic or message for the script content. This will be used to create the storyboard dialogue.
examples: Why you should drink more water daily
Kitchen hygiene tips people always ignore
How to properly store food in the fridge
The right way to sharpen a pencil
Why your phone battery drains so fast

promptLanguage.title: 4. Prompt Language
promptLanguage.description: Language for generating image and video prompts

dialogueLanguage.title: 5. Dialogue Language
dialogueLanguage.description: Language for spoken dialogue in the storyboard scripts

personality.title: 6. Character Personality
personality.description: The personality style that defines how the character speaks and behaves

enumDescriptions.engaging-narrator: Captivating storyteller that draws the audience in with interesting narrative
enumDescriptions.cute-complaining: Adorable appearance with a whiny, complaining personality (น่ารักแต่ขี้บ่น)
enumDescriptions.pretty-sharp-tongued: Beautiful but sarcastic, brutally honest (สวยปากร้าย)
enumDescriptions.fun-conversationalist: Upbeat, entertaining, lighthearted and fun to listen to (คุยสนุกสนาน)
enumDescriptions.friendly-peer: Casual and relatable, like talking to a close friend (เพื่อนคุยกับเพื่อน)
enumDescriptions.professional-expert: Knowledgeable, authoritative, and trustworthy expert (พูดดูเป็นมืออาชีพ)

characterStyle.title: 7. Character Visual Style
characterStyle.description: Visual art style for the character design in images

enumDescriptions.3D-Pixar: Bright colors, expressive features, Pixar/Disney 3D animation quality
enumDescriptions.Chibi: Cute anime style with big head, small body, large expressive eyes
enumDescriptions.Realistic: Photorealistic rendering with subtle anthropomorphic features

closingMessage.title: 8. Closing Message (Optional)
closingMessage.description: Custom message to include at the end of the video. Leave empty for default CTA.
examples: Check out our product link in bio!
Share this with someone who needs it!

aspectRatio.title: 9. Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: Video aspect ratio for the final output

enumDescriptions.9:16: Vertical format - Best for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
enumDescriptions.16:9: Horizontal format - Best for YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn

enumDescriptions.both: Generate both image and video prompts

totalDuration.title: 10. Total Video Duration (seconds)
totalDuration.description: Total duration of the video. Scene count = totalDuration ÷ sceneDuration

sceneDuration.title: 11. Scene Duration (seconds)
sceneDuration.description: Duration per scene in seconds. Scene count = totalDuration ÷ sceneDuration

includeTextInImage.title: 12. Text Overlay in Images
includeTextInImage.description: Whether to include text/captions overlaid on the generated images

enumDescriptions.yes: Include text overlay in images (e.g., captions, titles)
enumDescriptions.no: Generate images without text overlay (Recommended for cleaner AI generation)

maxPromptLength.title: 12. Max Prompt Length
maxPromptLength.description: Maximum character length for each prompt (set by media model limits)

examples.topic: 3 common mistakes people make when applying sunscreen
Why you need to replace your cutting board regularly
Signs you're not drinking enough water
examples.closingMessage: ดื่มน้ำเยอะๆ นะ!
